title: Streaming tool facade & compatibility adapter: multi-lang SDK examples
creator: Evelyn Park
description: Create a compact compatibility facade and example pack for TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs that lets existing clients opt into the new streaming + tool-calling + structured-output contract with minimal churn. Deliverables: (1) a small adapter library that maps legacy callback/Promise SDK patterns to the new framed streaming envelope (session IDs, resumable cursors, idempotent tool callbacks), (2) three language examples showing idiomatic usage (async iterator, evented callbacks, and generator-style resumable sessions), (3) migration guide and API reference docs, (4) end-to-end tests and short perf microbenchmarks. Focus on safety (schema validation of structured outputs), developer ergonomics, and preserving backwards compatibility for common patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter library published in monorepo under /packages/compat-stream-facade with version bump and changelog entry
TS/Python/Go examples demonstrate the same end-to-end flow: start session -> stream tokens structured as JSON envelopes -> invoke tool call events -> conclude with final structured result
Adapters support resumable sessions via session_id and resume_cursor headers and include example retry semantics in README
All examples include typed interfaces (TypeScript types, Python dataclasses/pydantic models, Go structs) and validation hooks
Automated tests cover idempotent tool invocation and schema regression checks (CI green)
Migration guide published with code diffs for the three SDKs and one app-level example converting a classic callback-based invocation to the new facade
Benchmark: streaming median tail latency within 1.2x of current non-facade streaming path for 1-4 concurrent sessions on CI worker profile

example_python_interface:
# Python: async generator + pydantic models
from typing import AsyncGenerator, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel

class Envelope(BaseModel):
    type: str
    session_id: str
    cursor: Optional[str] = None
    payload: dict

async def create_stream_facade(url: str, token: Optional[str]=None) -> AsyncGenerator[Envelope, None]:
    """Yield Envelope instances as they arrive. Consumer can 'async for env in stream' or use helper callbacks.
    Resumable via resume_cursor header.
    """
    raise NotImplementedError
migration_notes: Key migration guidance: 1) Start by wrapping existing call sites with createStreamFacade and consume as evented callbacks to preserve sync-style flow. 2) Opt into AsyncIterator/async for to modernize and reduce memory overhead. 3) Use resume_token for flaky networks; verify HMAC header if enabled. 4) For structured outputs, publish a pydantic/TypeScript/Go schema and enable CI schema checks to detect regressions early.
